name: The Velvet Ledger
description: A bank-of-the-future has scattered access records across its lab network, mixing genuine and misleading assets. Find the real credential and recover the settlement proof. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the settlement proof
tasks.description: A bank-of-the-future has scattered access records across its lab network, mixing genuine and misleading assets. Find the real credential and recover the settlement proof. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Look across the files offered by the service; several records describe candidate access cards.
Cross-reference each card with the independent settlement ledger. Compare the principal recorded there with the card holder's login.
Use the one card whose serial and principal agree across both sources to access the private settlement record.
